newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Rescued Colombian pilot falls out of helicopter.
newsitem.headline: Rescued Colombian pilot falls out of helicopter.

text.p: A pilot whose helicopter crashed was missing in the mountains of southwest Colombia on Sunday after falling out of the army helicopter that rescued him, radio said.

A private helicopter that Luis Eduardo Iglesias was piloting crashed on Saturday afternoon in Tolima province as he and an official of the state-run rural development bank Caja Agraria were flying between regional offices.

An army helicopter airlifted both men from the wreck site soon afterward, but RCN radio said Iglesias, who was not badly injured, had fallen out of the rescue craft and back onto a mountainside covered in dense vegetation.
A police spokesman said the search for Iglesias was continuing on Sunday afternoon. No comment or clarification was immediately available from the army.
The rescue mission was being coordinated from the town of Chapparal.
